entries.title: Bernoulli bond two-point operator on counting measure
entries.statement: Let G be a countable simple graph with uniformly bounded degree. In independent Bernoulli bond percolation at p in [0,1], tau_p(x,y)=P_p(x is connected to y by a finite open path), allowing the path of length zero. T_p has matrix tau_p and initially acts on finitely supported functions on V. Boundedness means extension to a bounded operator on l2(V) with counting measure. Let p_2->2=sup{p:T_p is bounded}; for infinite connected vertex-transitive G, pc=inf{p:P_p(|C(o)|=infinity)>0} and pu=inf{p:P_p(exactly one infinite cluster)=1}.

entries.title: Draft regular-tree threshold reference
entries.statement: DRAFT mathematical statement, author-checked and awaiting independent review: For independent Bernoulli bond percolation on the infinite d-regular tree T_d, d>=3, p_c(T_d)=1/(d-1) and p_u(T_d)=1.
assumptions: Each edge independently open with probability p

entries.title: Draft quantitative two-point operator continuation
entries.statement: DRAFT mathematical statement, author-checked and awaiting independent review: On a countable simple graph with uniformly bounded degree and adjacency l2 norm a>0, if the Bernoulli bond two-point operator at p0<1 has norm M<infinity, then ||T_q||<=M/(1-aM(q-p0)) whenever p0<=q<=1 and aM(q-p0)<1.

entries.title: Draft uniqueness obstruction to operator boundedness
entries.statement: DRAFT mathematical statement, author-checked and awaiting independent review: For independent Bernoulli bond percolation on an infinite countable vertex-transitive simple graph of bounded degree, boundedness of T_p on l2 rules out almost-sure uniqueness of an infinite cluster; in particular p_2->2<=p_u.
assumptions: p_u=inf{p:almost surely exactly one infinite cluster}

entries.title: Draft refutation of two insufficient spectral routes
entries.statement: DRAFT mathematical statement, author-checked and awaiting independent review: Pointwise exponential decay tau_p(x,y)<=C exp(-c dist(x,y)) with c>0 does not imply l2 operator boundedness. Also, using normalized random-walk rho, pc<1/rho is not the adjacency-Neumann criterion, and its proposed obstruction pc>=1/rho is impossible when rho<1. On T4 at p=3/4 the squared root-column norm is 1+4p^2 sum_{n>=0}(3p^2)^n and diverges since 3p^2=27/16>1, although tau_p=p^distance decays exponentially. The adjacency norm is 2sqrt(3), normalized rho=sqrt(3)/2 and pc=1/3. This refutes the insufficient operator inference, not the parent conjecture.

entries.title: Draft correctly normalized sufficient spectral criterion
entries.statement: DRAFT mathematical statement, author-checked and awaiting independent review: For an infinite countable vertex-transitive simple graph of bounded degree, independent Bernoulli bond percolation satisfies pc<pu if pc<1/||A||2->2. For a d-regular graph this condition is pc*d*rho<1 with rho the normalized random-walk spectral radius.
assumptions: Simple graph with uniformly bounded degree

entries.title: C0047 critical operator estimate remains an unverified bridge
entries.statement: For each prescribed finite symmetric generating set of each infinite finitely generated nonamenable group, finiteness of ||T_pc|| on counting-measure l2, together with pc<1, would imply pc<p_2->2<=pu by the draft continuation and uniqueness lemmas. This packet has not established that finite critical norm in general. Hyperbolicity and pc*||A||<1 are additional sufficient hypotheses, not assumptions of the original target. A September 2026 primary source claims the general critical estimate; independent mathematical verification and a compiled trusted-axiom receipt remain absent here.
